notes.title: Happy launch day! ABRISS v1.0 is here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dseLM0ZpS5Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi everyone!

The day is finally here! After more then 2 years of continuous work on our first game we are proud to say that ABRISS - build to destroy is now fully released.

With ABRISS v1.0 you receive a campaign spanning 7 worlds and several levels per world, a sandbox mode, in which you can experiment freely, a new Endless mode, where the goal is to achieve maximum destruction and thus the ultimate high score, and more like the photo mode, controller support etc.

We want to thank you again for all your support for ABRISS! Thanks for all the feedback and a special huge thank you to our communities on Discord and Steam. Please feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/DU5Ty8HzTt]official Discord server[/url] as we really love chatting with you over there. Tell us about your first steps in ABRISS if you are new to the game or let us know if something is not working as intended.

Cheers to all of you and thanks for being on this amazing with us!

[h3]Randwerk x astragon[/h3]

notes.title: ABRISS v1.0 launches on September 5, 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/53a00d90092c8289e87db2d47e106f9450245c75.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

Just a few weeks ago, we announced that we had to slightly shift our initially intended release date of v1.0 to take just a little more time for polishing. As we're making good progress, we are now happy to announce that ABRISS will now officially launch and leave early access on September 5, 2023!

If you own ABRISS already, you will automatically receive the full version once the update launches on said date. The new update brings in a bunch of improvements and features, including the much-anticipated world 7 and a new endless game mode.

Also, for a limited time only, the current price of 14.99€/$16.99/£13.99 will stay as it is – but starting September 21, we'll bump it up by just a little bit to 19.99€/$19.99/£16.99.

Thank you so much for all your support for ABRISS! Thanks to all the feedback from you and especially to our communities on Discord and Steam. Please feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/DU5Ty8HzTt]official Discord server[/url] as we really love chatting with you over there.

Cheers to all of you and have an amazing week!

[h3]Randwerk x astragon[/h3]

notes.title: ABRISS v1.0 update & Randwerk x astragon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/11d789fa456f052a037f852896bc9b5a6a73488f.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

A lot has changed in the background of ABRISS and we are happy to announce some of the changes today. Behind the scenes we are currently working hard on version 1.0, making it bug free and polishing it. We are close to the finish line, but it will take a little more time than we anticipated. So it might be possible that we can’t keep our original release date in Q2 2023. We will keep you updated on this topic in the coming weeks. Thank you for your patience and your ongoing support for ABRISS!

Additionally, we are happy to announce that ABRISS will be published by astragon Entertainment. You may know them from their games like the Construction Simulator, Police Simulator: Patrol Officers, or Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop. They will help us to publish the release version of ABRISS and bring the game to new audiences.

We are looking forward to releasing ABRISS 1.0 for all of you later down the road. Again, thanks to all the feedback from you and especially to our communities on Discord and Steam. Also, make sure to join our Discord in preparation for the big release. 

Thanks to all of you and have an amazing week

[h3]Friedrich, Johannes and Till[/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/8dacb3e4767cef0b2d53867f282627a3b3ba0244.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Surprise Major Update! This was supposed to be just 0.3.1, but it turned out that we changed so much more than we thought, so now it's a proper huge major update! We redid a lot of levels, since people were getting stuck on some of them, and gave the first couple levels some love, since they're the first ones you will see. We'd like to especially thank Kazuki, who submitted a bug report for a hard to find bug and gave us access to their save file.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]LEVEL REWORKS[/h3]
The Tutorial, 1-1, 1-2, 1-3, 2-2 and 2-5 have been reworked or entirely replaced by different levels. The old levels will enter the game again as bonus levels in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/3aa4874eb5f34ef489b1519c19648c72fdd78e9c.png[/img]
[*][h3]Sandbox parts added[/h3]
All remaining parts added to sandbox.
[*][h3]Scrollable build menu[/h3]
To support all parts in Sandbox, the buildmenu will switch to a scrollable mode.
[*][h3]Map 4-2 and 5-4 loading fix[/h3]
There were some errors in saving and loading 4-2 and 5-4.
[*][h3]Map unlock points system fix[/h3]
It was possible for unlock points to go negative, this is not possible anymore.
[*][h3]Map world switch buttons[/h3]
you can now select the next or last world, making fast navigation on the map easier.
[*][h3]Map autoprogress on unlock[/h3]
If you just unlocked a next level, the map will automatically move the selection to this level.
[*][h3]Free map navigation[/h3]
You can now move freely in the map screen by using WASD.
[*][h3]Map zooming fixed[/h3]
You can now zoom out and in with the scroll wheel in the map screen.
[*][h3]Improved VFX[/h3]
Some Buildblocks and Targetblocks now have improved destruction visuals.
[*][h3]Rotators directionality Gizmos[/h3]
Rotators now show in which direction they will turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/3e871836ea2b304f3dc6a7bc24899622659af4f9.png[/img]
[*][h3]Buildblock glitching reduced[/h3]
Physics glitching is reduced.
[*][h3]W1L6 visuals[/h3]
Visual revamp.
[/list]

Have fun!

- Johannes

notes.title: ABRISS 0.3 MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/f36741e17006a78462a6610314d8b397cf001db1.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

did someone ask for bonus levels? We have a whole world worth of new content for you! This will let you revisit some older worlds and their mechanics. We also added a shiny new overworld-map, as promised in the last update. Now it feels a lot more like a journey through the dystopian city-worlds of ABRISS.
We also added something you have been asking for for a while: STEAM WORKSHOP! You can now upload and download your own creations from the Sandbox.
Some basic systems were also re-written, so you can expect better performance, less bugs and better usabilty overall! See the changelog for more info:

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]NEW OVERWORLD MAP[/h3]
A new screen showing you all levels on a map! This also introduces an "unlock point"-system, which you can use to unlock bonus levels or skip levels you don't find a solution for yet. The points can be gained by completing a level in the least moves possible with a 100% destruction score. Don't worry - you get a couple of them from the start!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/700c5f2c96d26b7d0d6b939f4a8942280c0f45bd.png[/img]

[*][h3]STEAM WORKSHOP SUPPORT[/h3]
You can now upload and download constructs from and to Steam Workshop from inside the Sandbox! We're really excited for what you will create. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/1ab17d49365642faadac09ed815b5dcfbb1ffba3.png[/img]

[*][h3]World 1: EXTINCTION Bonus Level[/h3]
One extra hard bonus level: "Stairs"!
[*][h3]World 2: ANNIHILATION Bonus Level[/h3]
Another harder puzzle with world 2's rocket mechanics: "Monorail"!
[*][h3]World 4: EROSION Bonus Level[/h3]
"Slingshot" lets you revisit world 4 for another challenge.
[*][h3]World 6: RUIN Bonus Levels[/h3]
In the newest, sixth world of ABRISS, there are a whole 4 new levels waiting for you: "Storm","Half-Pipe", "Loop" and "Path"!
[*][h3]6 - 3 fixed[/h3]
100% are now possible!
[*][h3]Scene loading system redo[/h3]
Loading times between levels drastically reduced
[*][h3]Options Menu fix[/h3]
There were some performance issues with the options menu, as well as some flickering visual bugs. Those have been fixed.
[*][h3]new ultrawide resolutions supported[/h3]
5120x1440 as well as 5120x2160 are both available in the options screen now, as well as an experimental automatic mode which you can try if your resolution isn't listed! Should work in most cases.
[*][h3]New targetblock+debris styles[/h3]
We made some new animated targetblock designs and also changed some targets so they look more alive! Targetblocks connection dependency is also reworked.
[*][h3]some more targetblock system improvements + cleanup[/h3]
The destruction of targets should simulate more reliably and performant now.
[*][h3]Improved explosion VFX[/h3]
The explosions look a bit better now and also fit the range of the actual physical effect better.
[*][h3]Phase Transision UI fixes[/h3]
Switching from Building to Action phase etc. should not lead to unwanted UI overlap anymore.
[*][h3]Buildblock Deletion/Undo fixes[/h3]
dependencies between blocks are handled differently now, deletion should be more intuitive now
[*][h3]Rotator changes[/h3]
Rotator now hard stops starts and doesnt act like a hinge joint, and also connects on the top only
[*][h3]Hinge changes[/h3]
New model and texture for better readability, fixed some connection bugs
[*][h3]Impulsor changes[/h3]
Impulsor ejection force is more consistent now
[*][h3]Bomb changes[/h3]
Explosion force and range adjusted
[*][h3]General bug fixes and small changes[/h3]
ya know, some small fixes here and there, whatever we find on the road.
[/list]

Hope you have fun!
[h3]Till, Friedrich and Johannes[/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/e21875ca34f6855bee0ba7ede9f87c9abe42b1e0.png[/img]

Happy new year everyone!

We made some changes to the Buildblock System in the last major Update that caused the main targets to drop straight down, causing you to "win" before the first phase was even over, which caused all kinds of weird behaviour, mainly in 3-2, 4-4 and 4-7. This shouldn't be happening anymore.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]Main targets stick again[/h3]
Now they stay where they should be. 
[*][h3]Main Menu Loc text error[/h3]
Level names of "Arm" and "Raft" in the 4th world were switched.
[/list]

I hope you all have a nice new year, and we're looking forward to bringing you some more cool updates and content!

- Johannes

notes.title: ABRISS 0.2 MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/44d0b236194710fdb7d42ad1a1df0615d5ceec32.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

just in time for the Steam Winter sale, we're bringing you a holiday present: CONTENT.
The frosty sixth world, RUIN, brings you 7 more worlds, one of them a boss, the new IMPULSOR part and a new environmental mechanic. So everyone can try this new world, we've unlocked the first level for you already, even if you haven't played through the fifth world!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]World 6: RUIN[/h3]
7 more Levels, one of them a Boss Level!
[*][h3]IMPULSOR added[/h3]
Explosively detach parts into a direction with this new part, introduced in world 6!
[*][h3]New environmental mechanic - Ice[/h3]
Slide around on the new worlds frictionless grounds.
[*][h3]New targetblock+debris styles[/h3]
We've made a couple new models for the targets to be built out of, so the targets will look more diverse and cooler. Some of them are animated and will give a little more visual life to the levels. These aren't just found in the new world, but in old levels too!
[*][h3]new Music[/h3]
New tracks for the new world!
[*][h3]Targetblock System Improvements + Cleanup[/h3]
The destruction of targets should simulate more reliably and performant now.
[*][h3]Magnet Improvements[/h3]
Reworked how the Magnet affects physics and improved the VFX
[*][h3]Explosion System rework[/h3]
Improved the way explosions affect the Simulation and made some changes in the VFX to match
[*][h3]Achievement System Fix[/h3]
Ah yes, our old friend. After not getting any achievements at all, this time the system would give you too many. Hopefully, now you will only get the ones you actually should have.
[*][h3]Autorepair for Achievements[/h3]
For all those of you who just randomly got a bunch of achievements - we fixed that, so you now will only have the achievements you actually played free, and we remove the achievements that were wrongfully added upon startup. Take a screenshot while you can :D
[/list]

We didn't get the overworld-style map screen done in time as marked in the roadmap (unfortunately one of us got Covid and actually still has it), so we will propably add it in the next Mayor release 0.3 instead. The localization for the new world also isn't done yet, we'll patch that in starting next year!

Happy Holidays from us,
[h3]Till, Friedrich and Johannes[/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.1.26
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/8c8807c4bd8ece28bc2cb642487e27fb3fdeba64.png[/img]

Hi again!

Just some more saving bugs fixed - thanks to Tonyy from the Discord, We wouldn't have found it without you!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]Halloween is over[/h3]
Removed all pumpkins & bats. It was way too spooky for us, and we didn't want to live in fear.
[*][h3]Another Save/Load Fix[/h3]
*sigh* yes, it was still broken. It's really really really not broken now. Just works. I swear.
[*][h3]Autorepair for Save Files[/h3]
If you experienced some saving issues in earlier updates - don't worry, the data should be still there. The game will automatically fix your save files for you, so the old save files stay compatible.
[*][h3]More Graphics APIs supported[/h3]
The game should now run on more machines, there is support for both Direct3D 11 and Vulcan now.
[/list]

Content updates are coming soooooon...

- Johannes

notes.title: Update 0.1.25
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/2be43770ffebc5aff50aacf4a8d2e3ede224d6ee.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We've had some more trouble with saving & loading, thank you so much to Solo and GoneZero who provided their Save files! That made it actually kind of easy to find the bugs.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]"The Sun" Saving Fix[/h3]
The stats were not saved for the last level, making it impossible to get all achievements - now it works normally.
[*][h3]"The Sun" Buildground Fix[/h3]
The frictionless Buildgrounds in the last level weren't as frictionless as they should have been. Oops
[*][h3]End of game message[/h3]
You will now get a message after the last level ("The Sun") that will tell you that this is the last level, instead of just leaving you without a "next" button, wondering if this is it.
[*][h3]Sandbox Buildgrounds fix[/h3]
The buildgrounds in Sandbox mode were broken, we just forgot to update them after we introduced the snapping system for Buildgrounds too.
[*][h3]Full unlock fix[/h3]
There was a weird error where you would get MY PERSONAL SAVE FILE??? Very weird. It should not be possible anymore now.
[*][h3]Credits added[/h3]
We added Scizzoid, Solo and GoneZero to our Credits as community testers. Thank you so much again for the effort of reaching out and sending your files!
[*][h3]This game is now in Memory of Søren Krahl.[/h3]
He was a teacher, a colleague and a friend. We miss him.
[/list]

It's still autumn, so spookyness mode stays on! Stay tuned, new content coming soon...

- Johannes

notes.title: Update 0.1.24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/78be6d9d0b0f78ad55975e7a50431347a53ebf25.jpg[/img]


Hello everyone!

We've had a bunch of people from the community help out after last Update didn't quite works as planned - but now the achievements should really really really work. Thank you so much to Scizzoid for helping us by letting us check his Savefiles, it really helped a lot!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]Achievement System Fix Fix[/h3]
The expert achievements should [b]really[/b] work now! You will get all achievements that are stored in your savefile upon opening the game. The game will also fix corrupted savefiles automatically (hopefully not breaking any)
[*][h3]Achievement Popup Mode switched to immediate[/h3]
You will get achievement popups now immediately after unlocking them, instead of just getting them when closing the application.
[*][h3]Improved Snapping & Holding mode[/h3]
Buildblock snapping now supports half-steps and is also applied in holding mode. You can also drag parts through other parts that are in the way. This should allow you all to build more precisely!
[*][h3]Buildground Snapping[/h3]
Snapping now also applies to the Buildgrounds, making it a lot easier to line up your structures.
[*][h3]Buildground connection feedback[/h3]
If you connect a Connector or other connecting part to a Buildground now, the Buildground will also glow to show it is connected.
[*][h3]Part weight changes[/h3]
We are making the weights of our parts more uniform, so that everything of the same size and material will weigh exactly the same (they were a bit different before, for no reason). This should make it easier for players to estimate weights.
[*][h3]Tutorial turning-while-holding fix[/h3]
If you tried to turn while holding in the turning step of the tutorial, it didn't register. Now it's fixed!
[*][h3]Revert bug fixed[/h3]
You can revert normally now!
[*][h3]Main menu continue UI fix[/h3]
The "Continue"-button in the main menu used to only activate after the Savefile was loaded, which moved the rest of the Menu in an annoying twitch. We changed it so that it's just greyed out for the second or so it takes to load.
[*][h3]Zero gravity screenspace feedback fixed for Freecam[/h3]
The effect now scales with the different FOV of the Freecam.
[*][h3]Loading screen size fixed in freecam[/h3]
When in Freecam, the black black plane that was in the background of the loading screen wasn't big enough to cover the camera plane (because it has a different FOV). We just made it a lot bigger lol
[/list]

we also did a poll in the Discord, and the community decided: Spooky mode stays on! We'll see how long... 

- Johannes

notes.title: Update 0.1.23
notes.content:
Hi there!

as promised, the many Bugfixes that are in the Demo already are in the full version! Many of you have been waiting for the expert Achievements, just open the game to get all that you have played free until now.  There's a whole lot of medium-sized bugs we fixed:

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]Achievement System Fix[/h3]
The expert Achievements should work now! Just open the game, and you should get all Achievements you already played free immediately!
[*][h3]Improved Snapping[/h3]
Buildblocks snap a lot harder to each other now, which makes it a lot easier to build perfectly aligned structures. This also makes the holding-and-dragging mode more important for fine-adjustments.
[*][h3]Level cleanup[/h3]
We went through all Levels and found a bunch of random colliders that made the level behave weirdly, some excess lights that were barely visible but cost a lot of FPS and just made it a bit prettier.
[*][h3]Turning parts while in Hold Mode[/h3]
A lot of you have tried this in the Tutorial Level - now scrolling while hovering and while moving will both work.
[*][h3]New Anti-Gravity Effect[/h3]
We've had feedback that some people couldn't tell immediately if the gravity was switched on or off, so now we have a stronger screen-space effect that is enabled when the level is in zero gravity.
[*][h3]Additional UI feedback[/h3]
We added some subtle FX to the UI to guide players through the phases of play in the game.
[*][h3]Fixed "Black Plane of Death"[/h3]
YES OH MY GOD I FINALLY FOUND IT AND FIXED IT. Never again will the camera plane turn black randomly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/65efff4e513271c7cc05e4602b81b14733dee91a.gif[/img]
(Thank you to Lukas149 on Discord for providing the error footage)
[*][h3]Fixed camera plane behaviour[/h3]
At an earlier attempt to fix the "Black Plane of Death" I accidentaly made the camera plane not work properly. This is now fixed with the black plane bugfix, so now you should be a lot more aware of where you are in space with the camera.
[*][h3]Fixed 4k Setting[/h3]
For some reason, there were two 8k settings in the resolution dialogue. One of them was the 4k option, but it was labeled wrong. We'll change this resolution dialogue from the hard-coded one it is right now to a dynamic one that checks for your systems available resolutions automatically, but until then at least it's fixed.
[*][h3]Traditional Chinese Localization fix[/h3]
The name of the game in traditional chinese (一觸即發) was mistakenly shown in simplified chinese (一触即发). Please forgive us, we don't speak any chinese whatsoever and didn't notice - thank you to the user "Biscuit" in our Discord for pointing it out! Both of the names weren't in the main menu as logo, we also added this too.
[*][h3]More accurate destruction rating[/h3]
We are calculating the destruction percentage a bit differently now, we also added some invisible collider-Killzones in the Level to help you reach your destruction percentage goals in the game better. 
[/list]

We are also temporarily switching the Game and Demo to spoOooOky mode for the steam scream event, check the other post to see what that means! Hope you have fun!

- Johannes

[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

It's been a couple days now, and we're so glad the game is well recieved. Most reviews are positive, a lot of influencers play it, and the press reviews are good too. notes.title: DEMO 1.2 RELEASE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820047/94aba50897263cb5f5718c9e2e9111fe023d0818.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]DEMO 1.2 RELEASED[/h1][/b]

A new version is live right now... or is it? It actually has been for 4 days! We tested it with people from our Discord without telling you, muahahahaha. It has a lot of new Features, some of them you had previously asked us for - thanks again for the feedback, without you, we would be flying blind. 

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]Improved camera controls[/h3]
The camera movements are a lot smoother now, and we put a lot of time into visuals so you can see what is going on. Zooming in now will also give you a bigger tilt, so you can see your construct from the side.
[*][h3]New levels[/h3]
Some levels from the old versions were removed because they were too difficult, they were replaced with other levels. There are also levels not seen before, or that have changed so much that they're not recognizable!
[*][h3]Revert to previous turns[/h3]
If you want to undo one turn, now you can! No more resetting the whole level, just go back to where you were and modify your build(resetting the whole level is still possible, of course)
[*][h3]Remove parts with right-click[/h3]
You can now remove parts by right-clicking them(as long as other parts don't depend on them) 
[*][h3]Activatable parts[/h3]
Activate Rotators, Lasers, Bombs etc. by clicking on them, using a button or a shortcut on your keyboard!
[*][h3]Save and load constructs in sandbox mode[/h3]
You can now save complex builds in the sandbox and share them with your friends! This feature will be connected to Steam Workshop in the full version. You will be able to load builds from the demo in the full game, but not vice versa.
[*][h3]New Environments[/h3]
The black metal world hasn't been shown before, get a glimpse of it in this demo!
[*][h3]Better effects[/h3]
Bombs, Lasers, destruction particles: Everything has been improved for performance and visual impact.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming events[/h2]

We have made this Demo Update in preparation for the Steam Nextfest next week - we'll propably have some special events during that - and there's also the Games from Germany sale currently running, check out all the other great games from our german-speaking friends!

We're starting to put togehter the full version for early access release now, stay tuned! Release day is getting closer and closer...

Greetings from Germany,
Johannes
